title: 20 wishes for your 20's 💌
wishes: May your 20's be soft and full of joy.
May you always laugh the way you do, loud and real.
May every dream you whisper come true.
May your heart be safe and your peace be loud.
May you meet success before you finish chasing it.
May your hard days be short and your good days long.
May people treat you the way you deserve.
May your health be strong and your sleep be deep.
May money find you and stay awhile.
May you always have someone to call at 2am.
May you travel to places you've only seen in pictures.
May you stay curious.
May you forgive yourself quickly.
May you learn something new every month.
May your family be your anchor.
May your friendships be real.
May you never dim your light for anyone.
May love find you and be kind.
May God's favour follow you all year.
Happy 20th Birthday. You deserve everything good. 🎂
